bloodlines.arcana: Whenever you cast a personal-range spell, gain a luck bonus equal to the spell's level on all saving throws for 1 round.

powers.name: Touch of Destiny
powers.summary: Touch a creature to grant an insight bonus equal to half your sorcerer level, minimum +1, on attacks, skills, ability checks, and saves for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Charisma modifier.

powers.name: Fated
powers.summary: Gain a luck bonus to AC and saves during surprise rounds or while unaware of an attack, starting at +1 and increasing by +1 every four levels after 3rd to +5 at 19th.

powers.name: It Was Meant To Be
powers.summary: Reroll one attack, critical confirmation, or spell-resistance caster-level check after rolling but before the result. Use once per day, twice per day from 17th level.

powers.name: Within Reach
powers.summary: Once per day, when damage would kill you, attempt a DC 20 Will save. On success, remain at -1 hit point and automatically stabilize; Fated applies to this save.

powers.name: Destiny Realized
powers.summary: Enemy critical threats confirm only on a natural 20, your spell critical threats confirm automatically, and once per day you may automatically overcome spell resistance before rolling.

bloodlines.arcana: Whenever you cast a spell with an energy descriptor matching your selected dragon's energy type, add 1 point of damage per die rolled.

powers.name: Claws
powers.summary: Grow two claw attacks for rounds per day equal to 3 + Charisma modifier. They improve in damage at 7th level, become magic at 5th, and add 1d6 matching energy damage at 11th.

powers.name: Dragon Resistances
powers.summary: Gain resistance 5 to your dragon's energy type and +1 natural armor; resistance becomes 10 and armor +2 at 9th level, and armor becomes +4 at 15th.

powers.name: Breath Weapon
powers.summary: Use your dragon's line or cone once per day for 1d6 energy damage per sorcerer level, Reflex half, increasing to twice per day at 17th and three times at 20th.

powers.name: Wings
powers.summary: Grow leathery wings as a standard action for a 60-foot fly speed with average maneuverability, dismissing them as a free action.

powers.name: Power of Wyrms
powers.summary: Gain immunity to paralysis, sleep, and your dragon's energy type, plus blindsense 60 feet.
